assessments.name: Ensemble performance skills
assessments.description: Students demonstrate a strong capacity to decode and understand music notation and to perform as part of an ensemble with an awareness of their fellow musicians.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test
assessments.length: Show you can perform in an ensemble

assessments.name: Assessment Task 1: Band arranging
assessments.description: Arrange a short piece or excerpt from a piece for school concert band including poly-technicality. Your piece should be between 16 and 40 bars long.

assessments.name: Assessment Task 2: Choir arranging
assessments.description: Arrange a short song or excerpt from a song (e.g. the chorus of a song) for school choir SAB with piano accompaniment.
